Package Models

Class Player

java.lang.Object
Models.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game, encapsulating all relevant attributes such as name, color, owned countries and continents, a list of orders, number of unallocated armies, card ownership, negotiation states, and more. This class provides functionalities for managing player actions, orders issuance, card usage, and game state interactions.

    • createDeployOrder

      public void createDeployOrder(String p_commandEntered)
      Creates a deploy order based on the given command. Parses the command to extract the target country and number of armies. Validates the number of armies in the deploy order against player's unallocated armies. Adds the deploy order to the order list if validation passes, otherwise sets an error log.
      Parameters:
      p_commandEntered - The command entered by the player.

    • validateDeployOrderArmies

      Parameters:
      p_player - The player for whom the validation is performed.
      p_noOfArmies - The number of armies in the deploy order.
      Returns:
      True if the number of armies exceeds unallocated armies, false otherwise.

    • issue_order

      public void issue_order(IssueOrderPhase p_issueOrderPhase) throws InvalidCommand, IOException, InvalidMap
      Issues an order by prompting the provided IssueOrderPhase to ask for an order from this player. Throws exceptions if the command is invalid or if there are issues with the map.
      Parameters:
      p_issueOrderPhase - The phase responsible for asking the player for an order.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the issued command is invalid.
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.
      InvalidMap - If there are issues with the map.

    • createAdvanceOrder

      public void createAdvanceOrder(String p_commandEntered, GameState p_gameState)
      Creates an advance order based on the provided command and game state. Parses the command to extract the source country, target country, and number of armies. Checks if the command arguments are valid and if the countries are adjacent. If all conditions are met, adds the advance order to the order list for execution. Otherwise, sets an error log.
      Parameters:
      p_commandEntered - The command entered by the player.
      p_gameState - The current state of the game.

    • checkAdjacency

      public boolean checkAdjacency(GameState p_gameState, String p_sourceCountryName, String p_targetCountryName)
      Checks if the target country is adjacent to the source country. Retrieves the source and target countries from the game state and verifies adjacency. If the target country is not adjacent to the source country, sets an error log.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current state of the game.
      p_sourceCountryName - The name of the source country.
      p_targetCountryName - The name of the target country.
      Returns:
      True if the target country is adjacent to the source country, false otherwise.

    • assignCard

      public void assignCard()
      Assigns a card to the player as a reward for successful conquest if the player hasn't already earned the maximum cards allowed per turn. Adds the card to the player's list of owned cards and sets the appropriate log message. Marks that the player has earned a card for this turn.

    • resetNegotiation

      public void resetNegotiation()
      Resets the list of players negotiated with by this player. Clears the list of negotiated players.

    • checkCardArguments

      public boolean checkCardArguments(String p_commandEntered)
      Checks if the arguments provided in the card command are valid based on the command type. For "airlift" command, expects 4 arguments. For "blockade", "bomb", or "negotiate" commands, expects 2 arguments.
      Parameters:
      p_commandEntered - The command entered by the player.
      Returns:
      True if the arguments are valid for the specified command, false otherwise.

    • handleCardCommands

      public void handleCardCommands(String p_commandEntered, GameState p_gameState)
      Handles the execution of card commands based on the provided command and game state. Parses the command and creates the corresponding card order. Validates the order and adds it to the order list if valid. Updates the player's log and the game state log accordingly.
      Parameters:
      p_commandEntered - The command entered by the player.
      p_gameState - The current state of the game.
